# `aitbc config reset`

Reset the local or global configuration to defaults.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config reset [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--global` | flag | `false` | no | Reset global config |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config reset
```
